description: On `/[locale]/dashboard/job-applications` and its detail page `/[locale]/dashboard/job-applications/[id]`, no user-facing English interface text appears in fr, de or it. That includes visible text, validation messages, toasts, alerts and screen-reader labels and announcements. en stays exactly as it is today.

userStories.title: The Kanban board and quick add speak the page language
userStories.description: As a fr/de/it user tracking applications, I want the board's columns, quick-add form, toasts and labels in my language, so that the page doesn't switch to English.
acceptanceCriteria: Columns. In fr, de and it on `/[locale]/dashboard/job-applications`, each column header and the collapsed vertical label show the `jobs.statuses` value (fr "Enregistré", "Postulé", "En entretien", "Offre", "Refusé", "Accepté", "Décliné"). No column aria-label contains an English status.

Quick add. The quick-add modal's status badge is localized. Each of the six validation messages appears in the page language when its rule is broken: empty title, empty company, title over 255 characters, company over 255 characters, invalid URL, URL over 2000 characters.
Toasts and fallbacks. A failed status change, a failed delete, and a quick-add failure with no server message each show their message in the page language.

Labels. The card aria-label, the "remove status filter" pill label, the mobile "close filters" button, the list-view card menu button and the interview-type tooltip contain no English in fr, de and it. The link badge uses the locale's singular/plural form.
Not logged in. The "must be logged in" alert from the list-view card reads in the page language.
en unchanged. Every en string listed above renders exactly as before.

FR-1: One source per string. Status labels come from `jobs.statuses`, and the other strings from `common.json` (`kanban.*`, `jobApplications.*`, root keys) or `jobs.json`. Hard-coded English remains only as an unreachable type-safety fallback.
FR-2: Every new key exists, non-empty, in all four locales. The existing `src/locales/locale-parity.test.ts` enforces this.
FR-3: No new dependency. The dnd-kit `accessibility` prop is part of the installed `@dnd-kit/core`.
FR-4: en text unchanged, except the drag-and-drop announcements and instructions (US-003), whose en wording replaces the library default.
Regression constraint: Statuses are stored and sent as the same keys. Moving, creating, editing and deleting applications behave as before.
Regression constraint: Filters, search, sort, view toggle and the empty states render as today in every locale.
Regression constraint: `e2e/job-search-i18n.spec.ts`, which saves a job into applications, still passes.
Verification: The `CLAUDE.md` §14 baseline.

Verification: New e2e for `/[locale]/dashboard/job-applications` and its detail page, in fr and de, plus an en run proving en is unchanged. It covers: column headers and aria-labels; the quick-add badge and each validation message; the two toasts and the quick-add fallback (via a failing stubbed request); the card, pill and close-filters labels; the detail page with and without linked documents; the drag-and-drop live-region text for a keyboard move. The "no English" scan reads text nodes plus placeholder/title/aria-label/aria-roledescription, and a control case shows it catches an English status.
Verification: `ui-expert` on both pages in fr and de at desktop and 375 px, including the board with collapsed columns and longer German labels. `code-reviewer`.
FAIL condition: Any listed English string visible or announced in fr, de or it.
FAIL condition: Any en text change outside the US-003 announcements.
FAIL condition: A new key missing or empty in any locale.
FAIL condition: A status change, create, edit or delete behaving differently from before.
BLOCKER condition: A listed English string turns out to come from the server or stored data rather than the UI. Report it; it stays out of scope.
Out of scope: Server/API error text shown verbatim. Examples: "Job already saved" and "Validation failed" from `src/app/api/job-applications/route.ts`, and the browser's "Failed to fetch".
Out of scope: The global toast container's labels "Notifications" and "Dismiss notification" (`src/components/ui/toast.tsx:131, 161`). It is mounted on every page.
Out of scope: The French "0 candidatures" header plural (`job-applications-header.tsx:70`) and its `=== 1` rule.
Out of scope: Date-only values parsed as UTC (`new Date('YYYY-MM-DD')`), which is a timezone issue.
Out of scope: The H1 "Candidatures" vs the sidebar's "Mes candidatures" wording.
Out of scope: Changing en wording other than the dnd-kit announcements, layout, behaviour, the status colours in `JOB_STATUS_CONFIG`, and other pages.

userStories.title: Drag and drop is announced in the page language
userStories.description: As a screen-reader user, I want drag-and-drop instructions and announcements in my language that name the card and the column, so that I can move an application with the keyboard.
acceptanceCriteria: Instructions. The `<DndContext>` screen-reader instructions are localized in all four locales.
